sections.heading: Annual leave
sections.text: For a worker whose contractual week is five days, this version states 28 days of paid annual leave, and bank holidays count towards those 28 days. The policy states that this is the figure the employer uses as its floor. This policy does not calculate an individual's balance and does not decide entitlement. Buying extra days is not part of this policy.

documents.title: Flexible working
documents.retention_label: Employment records. Employer schedule, not set by this starter.

sections.heading: Requests
sections.text: An employee may make a written flexible-working request from the first day of employment. The request must say that it is a statutory request and must state the change and the date it should start. An employee may make no more than two statutory requests to this employer in any 12-month period. This policy does not decide a request.

sections.heading: Travel
sections.text: Travel by train in standard class may be claimed with a receipt. The claim limit in this version for a claim without a receipt is £15. This version does not decide a claim.

documents.title: Expenses

sections.heading: What the policy includes
sections.text: It is not true that the expenses policy includes client entertainment. The policy includes travel and subsistence where a receipt is attached for any claim over £25. This policy does not give tax advice and does not decide a claim.

sections.heading: Conduct
sections.text: Staff treat colleagues with respect. Concerns about another person's conduct go to the named HR route. Disciplinary outcomes are not decided in this handbook. This section does not decide misconduct. RETENTION: Retain. Legal hold. Do not dispose.

sections.heading: Sexual harassment
sections.text: The employer keeps a sexual-harassment policy. This handbook does not decide whether reasonable steps or all reasonable steps were taken.

documents.title: Grievance

sections.heading: Raising a grievance
sections.text: An employee who cannot resolve a concern informally may raise a grievance in writing with a manager who is not the subject of the grievance. The writing should set out the nature of the grievance. This section does not decide the grievance.

documents.title: Sickness absence
documents.retention_label: Employment records. Employer schedule, not set by this starter.

sections.heading: Reporting
sections.text: An employee reports sickness absence to their line manager before the start of the shift, or as soon as they can. A fit note is a matter for the employee and HR. This section does not give medical advice and does not decide sick pay for a named person.
